items.title: How property developers are benefiting from Australia's housing crisis
items.description: State and federal governments are offering incentives for property developers in exchange for more affordable housing. But a Four Corners investigation has uncovered major flaws in the strategy.

items.title: Self-managed super funds could have to pay compensation
items.description: The assistant treasurer is looking to revamp funding for the Compensation Scheme of Last Resort, saying that large super funds, as well as people with self-managed super funds (SMSFs), could be asked to chip in.

items.title: Trump vows to take over Strait of Hormuz and says US will impose fees
items.description: Donald Trump says the US is reinstating its blockade of Iran in the Strait of Hormuz and will start charging for ships from elsewhere to transit through it.

items.title: 'Frightening': Organised crime dominates the illicit tobacco market and it's now online
items.description: The process was simple and the service was speedy but the ease with which 7.30 acquired illicit tobacco products was concerning.

items.title: 'Kill him': Muslim man attacked on way to mosque
items.description: A Muslim man has escaped a near-miss knife attack on his way to evening prayers after police say he was set upon by two men metres away from his local mosque.

items.title: 'Jurassic family': Spielberg leads outpouring of tributes for actor Sam Neill
items.description: The New Zealand actor died suddenly at the age of 78, with Hollywood directors and actors and prominent political figures all paying tribute to a great of global cinema.

items.title: Violence against women under national spotlight after four deaths in four days
items.description: Experts are calling for more research and better funding for domestic violence prevention after four women and girls were killed in separate incidents last week.

items.title: 'I have everything to ruin your life': Sextortion threats on the rise
items.description: Major online platforms are accused of failing to deploy readily available technology to detect well-known blackmail tactics.

items.title: 25 years on, the outback murder of Peter Falconio still haunts Australia
items.description: Twenty-five years ago, the murder of British backpacker Peter Falconio and the abduction and escape of his girlfriend Joanne Lees in the remote Central Australian outback captured global attention. Today, it remains one of the nation's most infamous cases.

items.title: Jewish professor says 'intimidating' protest changed his life on campus
items.description: Melbourne University professor Steven Prawer hopes the Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion will lead to campus change, following a 2024 demonstration that saw protesters invade his office.

items.title: Richard Scolyer encouraged Australians to enrol in research. Here's how
items.description: In his open letter to all Australians, the late Richard Scolyer wrote of the pride he felt taking part in clinical trials. But what exactly is it like to participate?

items.title: Man who sneaked into Australia 45 years ago has lived in limbo until now
items.description: Kwong Wan Lo stowed away on a ship bound for Australia 45 years ago. With no legal right to stay, he built a life in Sydney anyway.

items.title: Yemen's Houthis target Saudi airport with ballistic missiles and drones
items.description: The Iran-aligned Houthi movement that controls northern Yemen has accused Saudi Arabia of launching air strikes against the international airport in Sanaa.

items.title: Video appears to show Thailand fire 'flashover' event, expert says
items.description: A video analysis of an explosive pub fire in Thailand, which killed 27 people, appears to show a flashover "point of no return" that would have made evacuation nearly impossible, an expert says.

items.title: Elon Musk’s criticisms of The Odyssey ignore an important fact
items.description: The tech trillionaire has spent a good chunk of 2026 yelling on X about how Christopher Nolan's adaptation of Homer's Odyssey "desecrates" the ancient poet.

items.title: Don't ask? Don't get: Five places to negotiate your bills to save money
items.description: Negotiating to reduce your spending and increase your income are tangible ways you can improve your financial situation right now.

items.title: ABC Places quiz: Where in the world are we?
items.description: Your challenge in the ABC Places quiz is to work out the location of 10 photos from around the world. Be warned: we might try to trick you.

items.title: Signs of sugar detected near centre of the Milky Way
items.description: Astronomers have detected signs of a type of sugar found in raspberries in gas clouds near the centre of our galaxy the Milky Way.

items.title: Breaking: Man charged with murder over death of 74yo Sydney man
items.description: A man has been charged with murder over the death of an elderly man who was allegedly attacked during a morning walk in Sydney's west.

items.title: Police charge alleged coordinator of Chris Baghsarian kidnapping and murder
items.description: A man accused of coordinating the alleged murder and kidnapping of Sydney grandfather Chris Baghsarian has been charged.

items.title: MMA upstart delivers knockout cognac gift to Brisbane Olympic committee
items.description: The "schmoozing", revealed exclusively by the ABC today, is part of a wider series of examples of attempted influence-peddling from businesses and sporting bodies before the Games kick off in 2032.

items.title: New pokies policies will 'make things worse' for problem gamblers
items.description: The body tasked with implementing Tasmania's new pokies policies says they won't work to reduce harm to problem gamblers and could make things worse. The Liquor and Gaming Commission was not consulted on the changes, which include ATMs in gaming venues.

items.title: 'Ovulating, come over now': The seedy side of online sperm donation
items.description: Australia is facing a sperm donation shortage and it is leading those desperate to find a way to conceive down some expensive and potentially dangerous paths.

items.title: RACQ accuses some retailers of trying to bring back 'unfair' fuel cycle
items.description: The RACQ says south-east Queensland motorists have been getting a fairer deal without a lengthy fuel price cycle, but there are signs of its return.

items.title: 'Gatekeeping septuagenarians': 'Inappropriate' TikTok video deleted
items.description: The National Trust of SA says one of its volunteers apologised after posting a social media clip labelling a group of disaffected members "gatekeeping septuagenarians" who were running a "stuffy museum".
